text: Hestia 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的会话界面增强插件，在会话页头部挂载外观面板，并通过侧栏与会话插槽加入整理和导航控件。用户可调节对话宽度、字号和字体，上传本地壁纸、切换明暗皮肤，也能为会话和工作区标色、置顶并按颜色分组。它还提供显示轮数和 token 用量的悬停信息、回到会话开头的按钮、轮次时间轴，以及带专注与休息循环、环境音和多种样式的番茄钟。选项保存在浏览器本地，无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务，适合希望定制 DSH 网页会话外观和管理长对话的用户。

Hestia customizes DSH web sessions with controls for width, fonts, wallpaper and skins. It adds session pinning, color labels and grouping, hover turn/token counts, conversation navigation, and a floating Pomodoro timer with adjustable focus and break periods. Settings stay in local storage.
想把 DSH 对话栏调宽一点，也想微调字号和字体。
有没有办法给会话区换本地壁纸，并调节背景透明度？
我想给常用会话置顶、加颜色标记，方便在侧栏里找。
能不能按会话标签颜色把侧栏列表分组？
希望悬停会话时能看到对话轮数和输入输出 token 用量。
长对话翻到很下面后，怎样快速回到开头或跳到某一轮？
I want a small Pomodoro timer in my DSH web interface with adjustable focus and break lengths.
How can I quickly navigate a long conversation by jumping to its beginning or a specific turn?
Hestia 的功能「会话外观调整」：打开会话页头部的“外观”面板，可用滑块和预设改变对话宽度、字号与字体，也能上传本地图片设置消息区壁纸、调整透明度并切换黑白皮肤；偏好保存在浏览器本地。
Hestia 的功能「番茄钟」：点击网页右下角悬浮球打开计时器，可开始、暂停、跳过或重置专注与休息阶段，修改时长、选择雨海等环境音，并切换外观；解锁后还能拖动悬浮球。
Hestia 的功能「会话置顶和标色」：在侧栏会话行使用图钉按钮置顶或取消置顶，并为会话和工作区选择预设颜色；置顶顺序与颜色映射保存在本地，颜色条显示在对应行上。
Hestia 的功能「按颜色分组」：从工作区侧栏的视图选项启用“按标识颜色”，会话按预设颜色归组并显示组名和数量；关闭时恢复原先的分组方式。
Hestia 的功能「会话轮次导航」：在长对话中使用上箭头加载更早历史并回到开头，或点击右侧时间轴上的圆点跳到对应用户轮次；悬停圆点可看消息摘要和时间。
Hestia 使用前须知：外观偏好、会话标记和番茄钟设置保存在浏览器 localStorage；上传的壁纸会压缩为 JPEG 数据并存于本地浏览器。

dsh-hestia README · Introduction：

Hestia · DeepSeek Harness Session Enhancement Plugin

Make your AI conversation interface smoother and more comfortable.
Conversation width · Fonts · Skins · Wallpapers · Pomodoro timer · Session navigation

简体中文 · English

dsh-hestia README · Introduction：Hestia is a standalone [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin you can install with a single `dsh plugin add` command. It adds an "Appearance" settings panel to the session page header, letting you adjust conversation width, fonts, skins, and wallpapers in one place — plus a Pomodoro timer (with 5 switchable style themes).
dsh-hestia README · ✨ Features：Click the "Appearance" button in the session page header to open the settings panel. Every option is remembered automatically.
dsh-hestia README · Conversation width：- Slider + presets (Narrow / Standard / Wide / Extra wide) to adjust the conversation column width, with magnetic snapping near presets for a smooth feel

dsh-hestia README · Fonts：- Font size: Small / Standard / Large / Extra large
- Font family: Default / System / Songti / Heiti / Microsoft YaHei / KaiTi / Monospace

dsh-hestia README · Background wallpaper：- Upload a local image as the conversation (message area) background; it is auto-downsampled to JPEG and remembered locally, persisting after restart
- An opacity slider (5%–100%) adjusts the wallpaper intensity; the image covers the message area, is centered, and stays fixed while messages scroll
- After uploading, the button becomes "Change image"; a thumbnail preview appears, and one-click "Clear" restores the plain background
dsh-hestia README · Skins：- **Pure white / Pure black**: one-click switch between light and dark interfaces

dsh-hestia README · Pomodoro timer：- A floating ball in the bottom-right corner shows a persistent countdown, automatically cycling through focus / short break / long break
- Adjustable durations, draggable position, and optional ambient sounds (rain / sea / water / fire); duration / sound / position / lock are all remembered locally
- The progress ring "erases" clockwise to show the remaining ratio, with a 1s linear transition forming a continuous, smooth animation (when half remains, exactly the left half is left)
- Click the palette button in the panel's top-right corner to switch between **5 component-level styles** that only affect the Pomodoro itself, decoupled from the global skin:
  - **Classic**: follows the global theme
  - **Tomato**: red fruit gradient ball + green leaf calyx on top
  - **Mint**: fresh sprout
  - **Ink**: black-and-white ink wash + solid lock + cinnabar red seal + monospace digits
  - **Amber**: vintage paper + Songti digits
- Each style has its own icon language: style-button preview icons, lock icons (line / solid), action-button icons (start / pause / skip / reset), and ambient-sound icons (none / rain / sea / water / fire)

dsh-hestia README · Session pinning：- Hover over a row in the sidebar session list to reveal a pin button; click to pin / unpin
- Pinned sessions automatically sort to the top of the list (within each group), with the pin always shown highlighted
- The pin set is remembered locally and persists after restart

dsh-hestia README · Color labels：- Hovering over a session row / workspace (folder) row reveals a color button; click to open a palette (8 preset colors); click a swatch to add a left color bar to that row
- The color bar is always visible; reopen the palette and click "Clear" to remove the color
- The color mapping is remembered locally and persists after restart

dsh-hestia README · Group by color：- In the workspace sidebar's **View options → Group by** menu there is a new "By color" entry; selecting it groups the session list by each session's color label (red → orange → … → uncolored), each with a colored group header + count
- Works regardless of the current grouping mode (it switches the list to a single flat list while active) and restores the previous grouping when turned off
- The toggle is remembered locally and persists after restart

dsh-hestia README · Session hover usage (turns + tokens)：- The hover card on a session row now shows an extra usage line under title / time / status: `28 turns · 46.7M tok in · 276K tok out`
- Data comes from two host-side session projections (same caliber as the stats row at the bottom of the conversation), read purely on the client — no host half needed:
  - `sessionStats.turns`: number of effective conversation turns
  - `tokenUsage`: input = uncached input + cache read + cache write, output = output tokens
- Turns and tokens are shown independently (whichever segment is missing is omitted); rows with conflicting titles (multiple sessions sharing the same name) are skipped without affecting the rest of the info

section: Session navigation (back to top + turn timeline)

dsh-hestia README · 📦 Installation：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hestia
```

> Requires a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) environment first.

After installing, restart dsh and open "Settings → Plugins" to see `dsh-hestia`.

dsh-hestia README · 🛠 Local build：```sh
npm install
npm run build        # tsdown → lib/index.js (host half) + lib/client.js (client half)
npm run typecheck    # type checking
```

Build output is in `lib/`. For local debugging you can install the directory directly:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/hestia-plugin
```

dsh-hestia README · 📂 Source layout：Features are split into modules under `src/client/`; the entry `index.ts` only does assembly.

```
src/
├── index.ts                  host half (empty apply)
└── client/
    ├── index.ts              entry: inject CSS, register skins, mount two slots
